critical_code_review_comments: AIChatWidget.jsx: onOpenChat effect has empty dep array — fine since handleIntent is stable closure over INITIAL_QUICK_REPLIES, but if quickReplies state ever needs to be consulted in handleIntent for cross-component opens, would have stale closure. Currently OK.

Bab1.jsx anti-copy uses document-level event listeners that affect the WHOLE app while Bab1 is mounted (right-click and copy blocked globally). Acceptable since user is on Bab1, but worth attaching to the article ref only for tighter scoping.

Bab1.jsx popup state is per-mount (useState). Refreshing /bab1 will retrigger the popup at 60% again — review_request says 'permanently in session' but it's only per-component-mount. If true session persistence is desired, use sessionStorage. Minor UX gap; not blocking.
chatBot.js fallback 30s default for page.text_content selector could be tightened by adding the bot message render delay (~700+text*6ms) — purely a test concern.
WA_LINK util usage in chatBot.js is good — phone number not duplicated. trackCta fires 'ai-intent-*' as expected by spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Chat Widget renders globally inside BrowserRouter (App.js). Greeting auto-fires once per session on first open (~900ms typing delay then message appears). Quick reply data-testids follow pattern ai-qr-{intent} (e.g. ai-qr-select-free, ai-qr-pay-transfer, ai-qr-rec-akademisi). Bab1 popup triggers at >=60% scroll inside #bab1-article; dismiss only persists per-mount, NOT across reloads. Bab1 anti-copy attaches to document, so be careful when scripting right-click flows. WA number is 628998553333. Backend was 100% in iteration 1 and not modified.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial test flakes — (a) 'Chat greeting' selector timeout was due to overall script context (subsequent QR clicks within same panel succeeded), and (b) 'Mid-CTA nav' failed in long-running test but passed in isolated rerun, indicating residual route/state from prior steps, not a real defect.
